package backend

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/Rocketable/platform/internal/rocketclaw/protocol"
)

// ---- Tree adapter: the only part that differs between the before and after trees. ----

// run.sh replaces BASE_COMMIT with the base revision's commit ID.
const equivTree = "before (BASE_COMMIT)"

// equivSkipped names surfaces this tree cannot capture.
const equivSkipped = "none"

// equivConversationIDs lists every conversation ID any table of this schema holds.
func equivConversationIDs(ctx context.Context, db stateStoreDB) ([]string, error) {
	return queryStrings(ctx, db, `WITH ids AS (
    SELECT conversation_id FROM managed_conversations
    UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM session_entries
    UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM active_turns
    UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM thread_queue
    UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM background_jobs
    UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM scheduled_messages
    UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation_goals
    UNION SELECT child_conversation_id FROM shadow_bindings
    UNION SELECT conversation_id FROM opencode_sessions
)
SELECT conversation_id FROM ids ORDER BY conversation_id COLLATE "C"`, "equivalence conversation IDs")
}

// equivOpenCodeServers lists the remote OpenCode servers whose sessions are stored.
func equivOpenCodeServers(ctx context.Context, db stateStoreDB) ([]string, error) {
	return queryStrings(ctx, db, `SELECT DISTINCT server COLLATE "C" FROM opencode_sessions ORDER BY 1`, "equivalence OpenCode servers")
}

// equivSidebarFacts returns a sidebar row's Slack channel and the cron path of the run it continues.
// Before, both are parsed from the conversation ID, as Web did.
func equivSidebarFacts(row *SidebarSession) (channel, cronPath string) {
	channel, _, _ = protocol.SlackThreadTarget(row.Conversation.ID)
	if source, ok := strings.CutPrefix(row.Conversation.ID, "web:"); ok {
		run, _ := ParseCronRun(source)
		cronPath = run.path
	}

	return channel, cronPath
}

// equivDelegations lists the IDs of a history page's delegations.
func equivDelegations(view *HistorySnapshot) []string {
	return view.Delegations
}

// equivSubagents lists none: this tree cannot tell a page's subagent sessions apart.
func equivSubagents(*HistorySnapshot) []string {
	return nil
}

// equivCronRun locates a cron run source; before, Web parsed it from the run's ID.
func equivCronRun(source *CronRunSource) (path string, at time.Time) {
	run, _ := ParseCronRun(source.SourceConversationID)

	return run.path, run.At
}

// equivSearchMessages fails when the search index is incomplete, since before it then misses messages.
func equivSearchMessages(ctx context.Context, s *SessionService, needle string) ([]MessageSearchHit, error) {
	hits, complete, err := s.SearchMessages(ctx, needle, nil)
	if err == nil && !complete {
		err = errors.New("message search index is incomplete")
	}

	return hits, err
}

// equivSidebarChats reads every sidebar chat.
func equivSidebarChats(ctx context.Context, s *SessionService) ([]SidebarChat, error) {
	var chats []SidebarChat

	for chat, err := range s.SidebarChats(ctx, noSlackLookups{}) {
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		chats = append(chats, chat)
	}

	return chats, nil
}

func equivPrincipals(ctx context.Context, s *SessionService) (map[string][]string, error) {
	principals, complete, err := s.messagePrincipals(ctx)
	if err == nil && !complete {
		err = errors.New("message search index is incomplete")
	}

	return principals, err
}
